origine_fr: Un homme qui porte un gros sac lié aux deux bouts : on le dessinait ainsi il y a près de 3 000 ans. Le sac, c'est 東, aujourd'hui 东, qui donnait aussi le son. L'homme et le sac forment désormais un seul bloc.
origine_en: A man carrying a large sack tied at both ends: that is how it was drawn nearly 3,000 years ago. The sack is 東, today 东, which also gave the sound. The man and the sack have merged into one block, no longer split.

phrase.fr: Le riz n'est pas lourd, l'eau l'est.
phrase.en: The rice isn't heavy; the water is.
